headline: TAAL Tech announces ₹5 interim dividend for FY27
hook: First payout of the financial year
summary: TAAL Tech has declared its first interim dividend of ₹5 per share for the financial year 2027, representing a 250% payout on its face value. Shareholders whose names appear on the company's register by the record date of November 13, 2026, will be eligible for the distribution. The company stated that the dividend payment will be credited to eligible investors by December 2, 2026. This corporate action comes alongside recent stock price appreciation, providing a cash return for existing shareholders.
whats_next: Record date for dividend eligibility on November 13, 2026
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive a cash payout by December.
winners_losers: TAAL Tech shareholders gain / none hurt
